name: OpenStreetMap contributors — villages, hamlets, neighbourhoods and named roads (Bangladesh extract)
notes: Geofabrik Bangladesh extract parsed locally with pyosmium. villages.csv: named place=village|hamlet|isolated_dwelling|neighbourhood|suburb|quarter (nodes; areas by centroid). roads.csv: named or numbered highways from motorway to residential, sampled every ~250 m. Community data: every row is unverified; ODbL share-alike applies to databases derived from it. The .pbf is not committed (fetch.py downloads it).
